field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Independent row reduction catches selected-candidate or headline inconsistencies.
field_principles.attack_matrix: Leakage, sign, tie, and protected-violation attacks test the main ways an energy result can be gamed.
field_principles.development_and_held_precommitment: A sealed split prevents result-dependent tuning or candidate replacement.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time catches comparisons that skipped exact backend or attack execution.
field_principles.exact_success_by_arm: Final exact outcome, not energy or format validity, is the headline decision metric.
field_principles.field_principles: A principle map carries the causal and authority boundaries into the artifact.
field_principles.field_provenance: Hashes, row IDs, and reducer receipts make every result field traceable.
field_principles.frozen_energy_formula_and_tie_rules: Precommitted scoring and ties prevent favorable held decisions after labels open.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A blocked task must name the upstream field, operator, expected value, observed value, and path.
field_principles.harmful_flips_and_recovered_failures: Both directions prevent net gains from hiding damage to previously correct selections.
field_principles.held_exact_energy_selection_ready_score: A conjunctive score promotes only a positive, protected, identifying held exact-decision gain.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict states positive, null, negative, or blocked evidence without promoting selector energy as authority.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declaring exact_solver_held_candidate_selection_no_llm prevents solver candidates from being described as LLM outputs.
field_principles.no_headroom_and_tie_rows: Explicit no-headroom and tie accounting prevents impossible wins from entering the headline.
field_principles.paired_effects_and_intervals: Paired intervals distinguish stable held effects from a few favorable units.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Unit, seed, arm, and candidate rows make every selection and paired effect reproducible.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Gate, split, backend, and candidate receipts prove the experiment was safe to start.
field_principles.protected_clause_results: Protected outcomes ensure scalar energy does not trade away load-bearing constraints.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: The comparison cannot improve by rewriting exact checkers, manifests, or conductor logic.
field_principles.protocol_recheck_receipt: Rechecking the actual manifest catches drift from the policy class audited upstream.
field_principles.random_seed: Declared seeds reproduce candidate perturbations and deterministic-random controls.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The checksum binds upstream gates, manifests, formula, candidates, code, and result.
field_principles.status: A terminal status distinguishes a completed held comparison from a gate-only artifact.
field_principles.tests_run: Executed commands prove the held reducer and adversarial controls ran.
field_principles.upstream_constraint_record_hash: The hash binds energy and exact validation to the same backend-neutral semantics.
field_principles.upstream_identifiability_hash: The hash binds the causal claim to the exact protocol proof that authorized evaluation.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Only exact backend validation determines final correctness; energy remains a selector.
